SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section I, Special
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. H. REGISTRY File No. S. R. D-7884 (C) 20/3/40 Station,）
Date March 20th, 1940.
Subject Horace John Hill Sampson
Made by D. S. McKeown. Forwarded by Supt. J. Mason.

Horace John Hill Sampson was born on
November 26, 1899. He joined the gaol staff in
1926 from the Royal marines from which corps he
received an honourable discharge with excellent
references. He served on the gaol staff until
October, 1938, when he resigned with an excellent
discharge. Following his resignation, he
proceeded to the U.S.A., but returned to Shanghai
after a few months. The senior members in the
gaol state that he was an exemplary officer, quiet
and reserved and with no bad habits. He is at
present residing at Room 509, Foreign Y.M.C.A.
He has been unemployed since his return from
very
America, but has/good prospects of obtaining a
position as purser on one of the vessels of
Jardine Matheson & Co.

D. S. McKeown
D. S.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

（批：19/3 as spoken / 20/3 Wotton St Alice informed E 20/3 FILE）

（印：INDEXED BY (S H) REGISTRY DATE 20/3 /40 af）

上海公共租界警务处。
特别科第一股
报告
（印：上海公共租界警务处 上海登记处 档案号 S. R. D-7884 (C) 1940年3月20日 警署，）
日期：1940年3月20日。
事由：霍勒斯·约翰·希尔·桑普森 (Horace John Hill Sampson)
撰写人：D. S. McKeown。呈报人：督察长 J. Mason。

霍勒斯·约翰·希尔·桑普森出生于
1899年11月26日。他于1926年从皇家海军陆战队
加入监狱职员队伍，从该部队光荣退伍，并获得极
佳的评价。他在监狱职员岗位上服务至1938年10
月，随后以极佳的评价辞职。辞职后，他
前往美国，但在数月后返回上海。监狱的资深
成员称他是一名模范警官，性格安静、内敛，且
无不良嗜好。他目前居住在青年会外侨宿舍509
室。自从美国回来后，他一直失业，但很有希
望在怡和洋行 (Jardine Matheson & Co.) 的一艘船
只上获得事务长 (purser) 的职位。

D. S. McKeown
D. S.

特别科副督察。

（批注：3月19日 口头汇报 / 3月20日 Wotton 通知 St Alice E 3月20日 归档）

（印：由 (上海) 登记处索引 日期 1940年3月20日 af）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ......
C.S.S, Special Branch ......
REPORT
Date March 20, 1940.
Subject Attached Newspaper Cutting From the North China Daily News.
Made by D.P.S. Denomanis Forwarded by Supt. Mason.

With reference to the attached cutting
from the North China Daily News dated 17-3-40, the
following facts have been obtained:-
The advertiser stated on the "Classified
Advertisement Form" that his name is Hamilton, c/o
Broadway Mansions. The name and address, however,
are fictitious as the only person by that name staying
at the Broadway Mansions was T.L.Hamilton, 37, American
news-photographer, who on the 27/10/38 left for Tokyo.
According to shipping lists Hamilton has not returned
to Shanghai since that date.
Further enquiries at the North China Daily
News office reveal that the person who inserted the
attached advertisement was a foreigner, age about 50,
and to judge by his speech neither a Britisher nor an
American.
The telephone number mentioned (86614)
belongs to T.B.Liu (楼□□), 59, Quai de France.
The address in question is a small Chinese sugar broker's
office, known as the "Shing Wu Co." A telephone call
at 8.30 a.m. on the 20-3-40 was answered by a Chinese
who on hearing a foreigner hung the receiver up.
There is nothing to the detriment of T.B.
Liu or his firm in S.M.Police records.

FILE
(印：Date 3/21)

D. P. S.
D.C. (Special Branch).

G. 90M-1-39
上海公共租界警务处。    档案号 ......
刑事侦缉处，特别科 ......
报告
日期：1940年3月20日。
事由：附《字林西报》剪报。
撰写人：D.P.S. Denomanis 呈报人：督察长 Mason。

关于所附1940年3月17日《字林西报》
剪报，已查明以下事实：
广告主在“分类广告表”上声称其姓名为
Hamilton，转交百老汇大厦 (Broadway Mansions)。然
而，该姓名和地址均为虚构，因为住在百老汇大
厦的唯一同名人士是 T.L. Hamilton，37岁，美国
新闻摄影师，他已于1938年10月27日前往东京。
根据航运名单，Hamilton 自该日期后未再返回
上海。
进一步向《字林西报》办事处查询显示，
刊登所附广告的人是一名外国人，年龄约50岁，
从其口音判断，既非英国人也非美国人。
提到的电话号码 (86614) 属于刘T.B. (楼□□)，
法租界法兰西外滩59号。
该地址是一家小型中国糖业经纪人的办公
室，名为“兴武公司” (Shing Wu Co.)。1940年3月
20日上午8时30分拨打该电话，一名中国人接听，
听到是外国人后便挂断了听筒。
在工部局警务处的记录中，没有任何对
刘T.B. 或其公司不利的内容。

归档
（印：日期 3/21）

D. P. S.
特别科副督察。
